A little about me

Hi, I’m Ziyi! I’m originally from China and came to Hawai‘i when I was four, so Honolulu has always felt like home. I’m happiest when I’m being creative, whether that’s drawing, watching films or getting lost in music.

I love to travel, and I especially love traveling solo to new places, at my own pace, and creating plenty of stories to share. I’m studying marketing at the University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa, and my goal is to work in entertainment, especially with K-pop and pop artists and in concert planning, helping bring big live moments to life for fans.
